results.title: SK hynix Developing New NAND Products for KV Cache ...
results.content: KV cache is temporary data required for graphics processing units (GPUs) to handle AI computations. As AI data surges, the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity for storing KV cache is reaching its limits. In response, SK hynix plans to develop new products that mount high-capacity NAND products near the GPU, allowing them to serve as an additional KV cache repository.
